description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Herd Baloth
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Resolve both Ghave abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
